## Orientation

This is the one fix for the review blocker. `replace-resolvers` and `close-library` are already on the phase branch. Do not change how close calls affidavit. Do not bring back `aa_resolve.py` or `artifact_store.py`.

Write root: `/home/andrewyin/orchestra/.worktrees/orchestra-callers--fix-dashboard-uv-env` on `task/orchestra-callers/fix-dashboard-uv-env`.

### Work-item (quote)

## Description

R2: Modules under `dashboard/` open the store by calling `adaptive_artifacts.project.open_store`.

## Approach

`dashboard/bin/dashboard` and `dashboard/bin/web` exec `uv run --script` on `dashboard/__main__.py` and `dashboard/web/__main__.py`. Those PEP 723 blocks list textual, or fastapi/uvicorn/textual, and the resulting environment cannot import `adaptive_artifacts`. Make the environment `uv run --script` creates for both scripts able to import `adaptive_artifacts.project`. Keep the launcher argv as `uv run --script`. Do not edit `tests/test_orchestra_callers.py`. Do not change `orchestra/close_batch.py`.

### Requirements (quote by id)

R2: Modules under `dashboard/` open the store by calling `adaptive_artifacts.project.open_store`.

### Design / decisions (quote)

## Invariants

Help does not import affidavit. No orchestra or dashboard module resolves `SE_WORKFLOW_STORE` or a private binding file.

## Assumptions

The dashboard process runs with the orchestra environment, so one dependency covers both trees.

dependency-direction choice: affidavit-on-aa-orchestra-on-both
store-resolution choice: open-store-in-adaptive-artifacts
